articles.summary: End-to-end autonomous driving increasingly depends on scaling training demonstrations, yet data growth does not guarantee proportional gains. articles.summary: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. articles.summary: An assistant monitoring a person performing a procedure is most useful when it can detect mistakes while there is still time to recover. articles.summary: It has been demonstrated that, in certain settings, large language models can perform weight-space programming to directly modify the weights of neural networks. articles.summary: Facial deepfake detectors are usually trained on blending fakes, where a generated face is pasted back into a real frame. articles.summary: World models aim to predict environment dynamics under actions, enabling the prediction of action consequences without executing them in the real world. articles.summary: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) become increasingly integrated into everyday life, their ability to provide safe and reliable assistance in realistic daily activities remains insufficiently explored. articles.summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the stage in which Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) advance their capability to reason over video. articles.title: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
articles.summary: Recent AI agents can generate playable games, but these games are not necessarily engaging. Mastery is a key source of engagement, yet designing for it requires extensive human play and tuning.
